description: This PHP class 'Api' provides methods to interact with Confluence's REST API, including operations like retrieving, creating, updating, deleting pages, handling attachments, and error handling.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A PHP class for interacting with Confluence REST API, including page retrieval, creation, updating, deletion, and attachment handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing base URL, username, and password for API access.

methods.name: setSpace
methods.description: Sets the Confluence space ID for content operations.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a Guzzle HTTP client configured with base URI and authentication.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles BadResponseException errors, providing detailed error messages and raising specific exceptions for common API errors.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Retrieves details of a page by ID, including its title, version, content, space key, and ancestor page.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of pages starting from a root page, optionally recursively including child pages.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Creates a new page under a specified parent ID with given title and content.

methods.name: updatePage
methods.description: Updates an existing page specified by page ID, with new title, content, and version number.

methods.name: showSourceCode
methods.description: Displays a snippet of source code with highlighted line and column, useful for debugging.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Checks if an attachment with a specific filename exists under a page.

methods.name: putAttachment
methods.description: Uploads an attachment file to a specified URL.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of an attachment, either from a file or content string.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads an attachment to a page, skipping if an attachment of the same size exists.
